testCases.label: Loose Equality (==) Check
testCases.description: Verifies that the equality operator (==) correctly handles type coercion, specifically testing if a numerical zero (0) is considered loosely equal (falsy) to other falsy types.

testCases.label: Strict Equality (===) Check
testCases.description: Verifies that the strict equality operator (===) correctly confirms that the data type and value match exactly, specifically ensuring a numeric variable is strictly equal to the number 0.

testCases.label: Loose Inequality (!=) Check
testCases.description: Verifies that the inequality operator (!=) correctly handles type coercion, specifically testing if an empty string ("") is considered loosely unequal (falsy) to other types.

testCases.label: Strict Inequality (!==) Check
testCases.description: Verifies that the strict inequality operator (!==) correctly confirms when data type or value do not match, ensuring a variable is strictly not equal to a specific value like `null`.

testCases.label: Logical AND (&&) Evaluation
testCases.description: Verifies that the logical AND operator (&&) returns a falsy result when one or more of the input values are falsy, demonstrating short-circuit evaluation.

testCases.label: Logical OR (||) Evaluation
testCases.description: Verifies that the logical OR operator (||) correctly returns a truthy result when at least one of the input values is truthy.

testCases.label: Null Truthiness Check
testCases.description: Verifies that the null value (`null`) is correctly evaluated as a falsy value within a boolean context.

testCases.label: Undefined Truthiness Check
testCases.description: Verifies that the undefined value (`undefined`) is correctly evaluated as a falsy value when used in a boolean context or with negation.
